import numpy as np
cond_metal = df['잔류금속 (wt%)'] > 5.0
cond_raman = df['IG/ID'] < 2.2
c_mask = df['등급 (A/B/C)'] == 'C'
df.loc[c_mask & cond_metal & ~cond_raman, '사유'] = '잔류금속만'
df.loc[c_mask & ~cond_metal & cond_raman, '사유'] = 'IG/ID만'
df.loc[c_mask & cond_metal & cond_raman, '사유'] = '둘 다'
